entries.why: Editable PDF copy registry. Edge renderer reads it and freezes it into issue_snapshot.
Generated Supabase types. Source is itself generated; never hand-edit either side.
Fee basis type + cents-safe multiplication, used by the frontend wizard and the draft-batch edge action.

Money formatting. render.tsx (below) needs it from a path that resolves identically on both runtimes; previously it was hand-duplicated inline in _shared/hireOrders.ts, which stays a re-export of this file.

Geist + Geist Mono bytes, gzipped then base64-encoded. BOTH pdfDeps shims embed them so the default theme renders with zero network I/O on either runtime; mirrored rather than hand-duplicated because the literal is still ~330KB even gzipped.

Inflates fonts.ts's gzip-compressed base64 back to plain base64 for a data: URI. DecompressionStream("gzip") behaves identically on both runtimes, so this is one implementation rather than two; both (NOT mirrored) pdfDeps.ts shims call it.
Editable PDF theme registry. The edge renderer builds its StyleSheet from it and freezes the resolved theme into issue_snapshot.
Hire-order document domain types (OrderData, RenderInput, etc). Both runtimes' pre-existing homes (_shared/hireOrders.ts, src/lib/hireOrders/types.ts) re-export from here instead of redeclaring.

The hire-order PDF renderer itself, so the settings editor can preview the real document in the browser. Only pdfDeps.ts (NOT mirrored) differs per runtime. The edge copy is prefixed with a JSX pragma (`prelude`) so it compiles without a repo-root deno.json, which every edge function would inherit.
The sample order both preview surfaces render. Shared so the editor's live browser preview and the server's 'Open exact PDF' cannot drift into showing different documents.
